metadata.name: n8n v3
metadata.description: Free and open fair-code licensed node based Workflow Automation Tool.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: N8N_PUBLIC_URL
environment_variables.description: Required public HTTPS editor URL, for example https://n8n.example.com. Configure an HTTPS reverse proxy on this host to forward to 127.0.0.1:5679.

before_install.en_us: n8n v3 removes legacy nodes, disables unverified community packages by default, shortens task runner timeouts and renames binaryData to storage. Run Settings > Migration Report on v2 first, replace removed nodes, and back up PostgreSQL plus /home/node/.n8n including its encryption key. This is a separate installation, not an automatic upgrade. Never attach the v2 volumes directly; migrate tested copies or export/import workflows and credentials. Use HTTPS for the editor. Migration: https://docs.n8n.io/changelog/v30-breaking-changes Before deploying, configure one HTTPS reverse proxy on this host to forward to http://127.0.0.1:5679 and set N8N_PUBLIC_URL to the public HTTPS URL. Open that configured URL, not the backend port. Set X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto on the proxy. Secure cookies stay enabled. Only Portainer and Dockge are supported because the other converters do not provide the required configuration input.
